notes.title: Visual Overhaul
notes.content:
This update's main focus is a complete overhaul of the visuals with new models for almost everything to ensure everything looks cohesive.


[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Added a food cart building from which travelers will grab food
- Added a time setting allowing you to control the time of day
- Completely overhauled the characters, terrain and more
- Fixed travelers standing up for a split second and sitting back down
- Fixed travelers not facing the correct way when sitting down
- Travelers will no longer sit around the barbecue. Instead, one traveler will now cook meat on the barbecue

notes.title: Patch 0.6.1 - New menu
notes.content:
[b]Patch 0.6.1[/b]
- Some small touch-ups to the map
- New main menu scene
- The pause menu now automatically closes when going into first person mode
- Removed all flowers and instead added 1 "Flowers" buildable, which spawns a few flowers at once

notes.title: First Person Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]First Person mode is here![/b][/h1]

You can now walk around your campsite freely, enter lodges, tents and much more!

[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[b][h3]First Person Mode[/h3][/b]
[i]- Added first person mode. Press space to hop in and out!
- When in first person mode, look at certain buildings / items and press 'E' to interact when the interact prompt pops up
- You can enter lodges, sit down and relax
- Enter a tent and write in your diary by interacting with the book on te left (Your diary saves, even if you close the game)
- Sit on benches
- Sit next to campfires[/i]

[b][h3]Other Patch Notes[/h3][/b]
[i]- Fixed tree leaves having weird edges
- You will now be able to see what the travelers are talking about from a greater distance
- Added a filter to the camera giving the world a 'painted' style
- Travelers will be much more expressive with brand new animations!
- The remove cursor is not off-center anymore
- You can now remove rocks the same way you can remove trees or any other buildings
- Trees now block buildings
- Rocks now block buildings
- Food will now spawn on tables when travelers arrive
- You can now change the zoom speed in the settings menu[/i]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.3 - Fireflies!
notes.content:
[b]Patch 0.5.3[/b]

[list]
[*] Fireflies now spawn at nighttime
[*] Improved UI in the main menu and pause menu
[*] 1000 traveler achievement has been downgraded to 750
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.2 - Black ground texture fix
notes.content:
[b]Patchnotes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new launch option that takes care of the black ground bug. If this causes your game to crash, selecting the default launch option will be the only solution for now.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1 - DOF Setting and More Campers
notes.content:
[b]Patchnotes:[/b]

[list]
[*] You can now toggle Depth of Field on and off in the settings menu
[*] The amount of travelers in your campsite does not cap at 500 anymore
[/list]

notes.title: Weather and Time of Day Update!
notes.content:
[b]First of all, thank you all for playing the demo and the amazing feedback![/b]

In this update we're adding the first version of the weather system and day / night cycle.
You can expect these systems to receive more updates over the coming days!
